description: Viadere RFC 9421 profile for business API requests (SECURITY.md 2.112). Generated by generate_http_signatures_v1.py (Python standard library + cryptography, deterministic ECDSA RFC 6979, low S). Verification order and error codes are normative.

positive.name: post_json_body
positive.description: POST with a JSON body: all six components, Content-Digest sha-256.

positive.name: get_no_query
positive.description: GET without a query string: bodiless components; @query is the lone '?'.

positive.name: get_with_query
positive.description: GET with a percent-encoded query: @path and @query are taken undecoded.

positive.name: post_empty_body
positive.description: POST without a body (cancel): bodiless components, no Content-Digest.

positive.name: parameters_reordered_with_alg
positive.description: Parameters in another order, with the optional alg naming the one allowed algorithm; created at the 300 s edge.

negative.name: duplicate_content_digest_field
negative.description: Two Content-Digest field lines (RFC 9421 section 2.1 would join them; the profile refuses).

negative.name: two_signatures_in_one_field
negative.description: Two members in one Signature-Input and Signature field.

negative.name: label_mismatch
negative.description: Signature and Signature-Input carry different labels.

negative.name: non_strict_serialization
negative.description: Signature-Input that is not in strict structured-field serialization.

negative.name: signature_not_byte_sequence
negative.description: Signature value that is not a byte sequence.

negative.name: components_reordered
negative.description: The right components in another order.

negative.name: bodiless_list_on_body
negative.description: A body request signed with the bodiless list (content-digest and content-type not covered).

negative.name: component_parameter
negative.description: A parameter on a component identifier (;sf).

negative.name: keyid_as_integer
negative.description: keyid as an integer instead of a string.

negative.name: created_in_future
negative.description: created more than 300 s ahead of the verifier.

negative.name: expires_too_far
negative.description: expires more than 300 s after created.

negative.name: digest_mismatch
negative.description: The body differs from the signed Content-Digest.

negative.name: body_without_digest
negative.description: A body and no Content-Digest field.

negative.name: digest_sha512
negative.description: Content-Digest with sha-512 only (the profile requires sha-256 alone).

negative.name: digest_on_bodiless
negative.description: Content-Digest on a request without a body.

negative.name: body_without_content_type
negative.description: A body and no Content-Type field.

negative.name: high_s
negative.description: The same signature with s replaced by n - s (valid ECDSA, not canonical).

negative.name: key_of_another_business
negative.description: A signing key registered by another business.

negative.name: key_of_another_api_key
negative.description: A signing key bound to another API key of the same business.

negative.name: signed_with_other_private_key
negative.description: Registered keyid, signature made with a different private key.

negative.name: authority_with_port
negative.description: Signed for the authority with an explicit port.

negative.name: query_added
negative.description: Signed without a query, sent with one.

negative.name: other_method
negative.description: Signed for PUT, sent as POST.

negative.name: replayed_nonce
negative.description: The nonce was already used with this key.
